title: Club
tagline: Club is a social app to share your TRANSACTIONS with your friends!
description:
Club is a social networking service where you can share transactions with your friends.
The information inscribed in the blockchain can be checked from etherscan and other services, but will the average user find enjoyment in this?
We didn’t use any complicated words (in fact, we didn’t use the word "NFT" even once in the app), but put it in a simple and fun context like "an app where you can share what you buy with your friends.
Inspired by Zenly and Swarm, we included a number of fun game elements, such as the Mayer feature and weekly rankings with friends.
We believe that Crypto payments will be increasingly used in a variety of settings, including actual stores, in the future. And every time that happens, "Club" will get more exciting!

Pitch Deck: https://www.slideshare.net/ssusera2641c/clubslidepdf
how_its_made:
To use this project, you must first obtain a subdomain (e.g. username.byclub.in) of byclub.in, the DNS registered with ENS. This is used as the user ID within this project.
The Covalent API is used to retrieve transactions and NFT metadata to be displayed in the timeline.
This project is available as a mobile app and can be used on iOS/Android. Development was also cross-platform using Flutter.
Off-chain data storage was done with Firebase Firestore. Timelines and search indexes are also done here.
Transactions are retrieved by periodic execution, and the wallet transactions that come up in this project are periodically retrieved and stored in the off-chain database.
